overview.mechanism: Acetate-containing electrolyte solution; verify exact potassium, calcium, magnesium and sodium concentrations from the registered product.
uses: Intravenous fluid/electrolyte therapy according to the clinical indication and the exact product composition.

paragraphs.text: The registry heading groups product records; it does not supply an individualized infusion rate or prove equivalence with another balanced solution. Check the complete bag composition and approved insert before use, particularly when fluid or electrolyte handling is impaired.

sources.citation: FDA Philippines. Product registration records (raw registry fields retained).

revision_log.change: Source-linked descriptive overview and clinical evidence; no new unsupported dose recommendation or inferred dialysis schedule.
